name: USGS OFR 03-85 original south San Miguel habitat polygons

rights.license: U.S. Geological Survey public-domain work; source attribution requested in original metadata

temporal.update_cadence: Static source; monthly original-archive and independent-closure review

provenance.access_service: Original USGS publication archive; independent of NOAA H13084 multibeam acquisition
transformations: Read original shapefile and metadata from hash-pinned tarball; repair three invalid polygons only for research overlap counts.
Project NAD83 habitat polygons onto original NOAA MLLW native refinement cells and count hard/mixed intersections without interpolation.

evidence.supports: Original USGS catalog lists San Miguel habitat shapefile and downloadable tar archive.
Original 703,280-byte archive was opened and SHA-256 pinned; 2,238 hard, 621 mixed and 12 soft polygons. Metadata reports roughly 10 m horizontal accuracy and says not suitable for navigation.
Separate original NOAA MLLW multibeam survey used only for native depth and uncertainty intersection.

limitations: Historical hand-interpreted substrate is not a current rock or boulder inventory or verified catch location.
Native depth, MPA, federal area, historical hazard and ENC danger screens are research gates, not chart or legal clearance.
H13084 remains held from target publication; original source overlap counts contain no fishing coordinates or export geometry.
